title: Domain Modeling Made Functional - Scott Wlaschin
summary: Scott Wlaschin's NDC talk on using statically typed functional programming, F# in particular, to model a business domain. Types are used to represent the domain precisely and to encode business rules so that illegal states cannot be built, with the compiler acting as an instant unit test.
why: HN people recommend it as an eye-opening talk whose domain-modeling ideas carry over to other languages and make a strong compiler feel like a coding partner.

quote.text: If anyone is looking for a really eye-opening video take a look at that this.
